title: the dream adaptation (plz don’t mention the movie to me) ✨ #awrinklei...
transcript: wild nights are my glory hello from DC we're about to see a wrinkle in time which is one of my favorite favorite favorite favorite books of all time with one of my favorite actors amber gray I'm living my best life and I love arena stage and it really was a dream I've been waiting for this show for so long two years ago I went to the very first ever public performance of a wrinkle in time it was a work in progress showing at new york stage and film at vassar college the music wasn't finished yet so I literally had to chant the lyrics it was so cool but I was very excited to see it finally finished especially because this was being composed by one of my favorites Heather Christian it's hard to describe Heather's music but it's super complex it feels chorale with crazy chords and almost mathematical which to me made it perfect for a wrinkle in time yes it's a children's book but it has a lot of math and physics and I just thought this musical was such a testament to the original source material from the book of the musical by lauren yee to the puppets designed by james ortiz I literally cried when aunt beast appeared and obviously the cast I just thought the casting was so well done a perfect amber gray role I love mrs. whatsit and she fully embodied her and while I am normally anti adults playing kids in this case it really didn't bother me especially because taylor iman jones looked fourteen I don't know maybe it was the wig but she’s just so good she was my angry perfect little meg and calvin and charles wallace I love them all this is a show that will not be for everyone it's a little weird it's a little artsy but it was very much a show for me and that is all I could ever dream of
